summary: A row of eight filter chips that scrolls sideways inside a narrow frame, with a fade where more chips are hidden.
use: A filter or message-type row on a phone that must scroll without clipping the 44px touch area of its chips.
spec: `<ChipRow label="Filter chats" fade>` wraps the chips in one scrolling group
`<Chip label={f} selected={active === f} onclick={() => (active = f)} />` makes each one a toggle
